- Namespace: `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.Strategies`

## Summary

#### SelectConnection

`string SelectConnection(IReadOnlyList<DataverseConnection> connections, IThrottleTracker throttleTracker, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, int> activeConnections)`
